g1.label: 1. When is the course?
g1.why: The recording says the first-aid course is next Saturday morning.

g2.label: 2. Where is it held?
g2.why: The recording says the course will take place in the sports hall.

g3.label: 3. Who teaches the course?
g3.why: The recording says the course will be taught by a trainer from the Red Cross.

g4.label: 4. What should students bring?
g4.why: The recording says to wear comfortable clothes for kneeling and moving around.

g5.label: 5. What do students receive?
g5.why: The recording says students will receive an official first-aid certificate.

g6.label: 6. Why does Emma want the course?
g6.why: The recording says Emma has started babysitting and wants to know what to do if a child gets hurt.

g7.label: 7. What worries Tom?
g7.why: The recording says Tom feels a bit faint whenever he sees blood.

g8.label: 8. What do they decide to do?
g8.why: The recording says they decide to sign up together on the school website right away.

g1.label: 1. Lena's brother touched a hot cooker
g1.why: The text says treating burns means cooling the skin under running water.

g2.label: 2. Man breathing but won't wake up
g2.why: The text says the recovery position is for someone unconscious but still breathing.

g3.label: 3. Mia's leg won't stop bleeding
g3.why: The text says stopping bleeding means pressing a clean cloth onto the wound.

g4.label: 4. Player's heart had stopped
g4.why: The text says CPR is chest compressions to keep blood moving when the heart has stopped.

g5.label: 5. Students pay to take the course
g5.why: The text says the course is completely free.

g6.label: 6. Late students might not join
g6.why: The text confirms anyone who is late may not be allowed to join.

g7.label: 7. No break during the course
g7.why: The text says there is a short break in the middle of the course.

g8.label: 8. Phones used freely during exercises
g8.why: The text says mobile phones must be switched off during the practical exercises.
